request: Rank the 4 best Ford Mustang generations overall across the full production run. Use 4 different generations when available, with one representative version from each generation. If the model has fewer than 4 true generations, use the most important era-defining versions across its history.
title: THE BEST FORD MUSTANG GENERATIONS
close_narration: So, would you go for the clinching GT350 or the legendary Fastback? Let us know!
order_rationale: Ranked by weighted enthusiast desirability, driving engagement, historical significance, performance, collectibility, and value—not chronology.

entries.name: Fifth Generation GT
entries.label: RETRO REVIVAL
entries.one_line_fact: Let's rank the best Ford Mustang generations! At number four, we've got the Fifth Generation GT. Introduced in 2005 for $26,000, it revived America's love for classic styling. With 300 horsepower and those retro vibes, it was both a trip down memory lane and a modern muscle experience.
entries.ranking_case: The fifth generation’s retro styling and performance boost revitalized the Mustang for a new era.

entries.name: Fox Body LX 5.0
entries.label: 80S LEGEND
entries.one_line_fact: Then, there's the Fox Body LX 5.0. Debuting in 1979 at just $8,700, this boxy classic became the 80s icon with its 225 horsepower under the hood. Its simplistic design remains timeless, and today, its value has soared to $34K, a testament to its enduring appeal.
entries.ranking_case: The Fox Body reignited Mustang's performance culture and remains beloved for its tunability and affordability.

entries.name: First Generation Fastback
entries.label: ICONIC MUSCLE
entries.one_line_fact: Ah, the First Generation Fastback—where it all truly began. In 1965, this beauty hit the streets at $2,400, offering 271 horsepower. Its striking fastback roofline carved a place in American culture, though newer models outpaced it. Now, classic status pushes its value to $36K.
entries.ranking_case: The 1965 Fastback is cherished for its revolutionary design, performance capabilities, and significant cultural impact.

research_sources.title: Pony Up: The Legend of the Ford Mustang

entries.name: Sixth Generation Shelby GT350
entries.label: TRACK TITAN
entries.one_line_fact: Finally, the Sixth Generation Shelby GT350 takes the crown. Unveiled in 2015 for $49,395, this track titan wields 526 horsepower. With an aerodynamic body and Shelby badging, it merges raw power with sleek design. Having redefined performance, it's no wonder its value climbs to $80K.
entries.ranking_case: The GT350 pairs cutting-edge performance with heritage, making it an all-time favorite among driving enthusiasts.
